Once the copy is refreshed and you have picked A or B, I run the full test suite and finish.

engineer_json.question: The reviewer found that the payments list told the phone app two of its fields (how a payment was taken, and whether it worked) were free text, when the database only ever holds a few fixed words. I fixed the server so it now names those fixed words; that fix is committed on the phase branch (c0133a2, with its record in 76bdea5). But the phone app keeps its own copy of the server's description, written on 12 November before this fix, and the check that compares the two now fails, as it should, because the copies differ. I cannot update the app's copy from inside the sandbox. The decision I need: please refresh the phone app's copy of the description on its branch phase-372-payment-api-routes-and-the-app from backend commit 76bdea5 (the same way as on 12 November), and leave the desktop's copy of the app on that branch. Then restart this build so it can run the full test run and update the close-out papers. Or tell me to undo the fix and file it for the screens phase instead.
